# Parameter dictionary

Every value you return is a number from 0 to 1. Real ranges below show what 0 and 1 mean.

## Scalars

Format: id | group | real range (0 to 1) | neutral | meaning. The scale says how 0..1 maps: lin and db and bipolar are straight lines, log is exponential.

- src.harm_mix | tone | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 1.0 | Level of the partial bank.
- src.noise_mix | tone | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.1 | Level of the shaped noise.
- src.grain_mix | tone | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Level of the grain cloud (not played until M4).
- src.tilt | tone | -24.0 to 6.0 dB/oct (lin) | neutral -6.0 | Slope of partial levels. Lower is duller.
- src.oddeven | tone | -1.0 to 1.0 (bipolar) | neutral 0.0 | Odd against even partials. Positive is hollow.
- src.stretch | tone | 0.0 to 0.01 (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Inharmonicity B in f_k = k f0 sqrt(1 + B k^2).
- src.jitter | tone | 0.0 to 50.0 cents (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Slow random detune of each partial.
- src.modal | tone | 0.0 to 2.0 (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Ratio table: 0 harmonic, 1 drumhead, 2 bar.
- src.damp | shape | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.0 | How much faster high partials die than low ones.
- src.f1_freq | tone | 200.0 to 1200.0 Hz (log) | neutral 600.0 | First formant centre.
- src.f1_gain | tone | 0.0 to 24.0 dB (lin) | neutral 0.0 | First formant boost.
- src.f2_freq | tone | 700.0 to 3500.0 Hz (log) | neutral 1500.0 | Second formant centre.
- src.f2_gain | tone | 0.0 to 24.0 dB (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Second formant boost.
- grain.size | tone | 0.01 to 0.5 s (log) | neutral 0.08 | Grain length (not played until M4).
- grain.density | motion | 1.0 to 100.0 1/s (log) | neutral 20.0 | Grains per second (not played until M4).
- grain.pos | tone | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.5 | Read position in the source (not played until M4).
- grain.spray | motion | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Random spread of the read position (not played until M4).
- grain.scatter | motion | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Random spread of grain timing (not played until M4).
- fold.amt | grit | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Wavefolder drive.
- fold.bias | grit | -1.0 to 1.0 (bipolar) | neutral 0.0 | Wavefolder offset. Adds even harmonics.
- clang.amt | grit | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Metallic phase and ring modulation.
- clang.ratio | grit | 0.25 to 8.0 (log) | neutral 1.41 | Modulator frequency over f0.
- comb.amt | grit | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Resonant comb mix.
- comb.tune | grit | 0.5 to 4.0 (log) | neutral 1.0 | Comb pitch over f0.
- comb.decay | grit | 0.01 to 2.0 s (log) | neutral 0.2 | Comb ring time.
- smear.amt | grit | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Spectral blur (v1, not played).
- smear.freeze | grit | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Spectral freeze (v1, not played).
- crush.bits | grit | 2.0 to 16.0 bits (lin) | neutral 16.0 | Bit depth.
- crush.rate | grit | 500.0 to 48000.0 Hz (log) | neutral 48000.0 | Sample-and-hold rate.
- tape.amt | grit | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Wow, flutter and dropouts.
- filt.cutoff | shape | 20.0 to 20000.0 Hz (log) | neutral 20000.0 | Filter cutoff.
- filt.res | shape | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Filter resonance.
- filt.morph | shape | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Low-pass at 0, band-pass at 0.5, high-pass at 1.
- filt.track | shape | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.0 | How far the cutoff follows pitch.
- env.attack | shape | 0.001 to 4.0 s (log) | neutral 0.005 | Rise time.
- env.hold | shape | 0.0005 to 2.0 s (log) | neutral 0.0005 | Time at full level after the attack. The minimum means none.
- env.decay | shape | 0.005 to 8.0 s (log) | neutral 0.3 | Fall time to the sustain level; ring time of a struck sound.
- env.sustain | shape | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.8 | Level held while the note lasts.
- env.release | shape | 0.005 to 8.0 s (log) | neutral 0.2 | Fade after the note ends.
- env.noise_decay | shape | 0.005 to 4.0 s (log) | neutral 0.2 | Fall time of the noise, separate from the body.
- env.pitch_amt | shape | -24.0 to 48.0 semitones (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Pitch offset at the start of the note.
- env.pitch_time | shape | 0.001 to 0.5 s (log) | neutral 0.05 | How fast the start pitch falls back.
- strike.click | shape | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Start transient.
- strike.color | shape | 200.0 to 12000.0 Hz (log) | neutral 3000.0 | Pitch of the clicks.
- strike.end_click | shape | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Closing transient.
- lfo1.rate | motion | 0.05 to 20.0 Hz (log) | neutral 5.0 | First LFO rate.
- lfo1.to_pitch | motion | 0.0 to 100.0 cents (lin) | neutral 0.0 | First LFO to pitch.
- lfo1.to_filter | motion | 0.0 to 4.0 oct (lin) | neutral 0.0 | First LFO to cutoff.
- lfo1.to_level | motion | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.0 | First LFO to level.
- lfo2.rate | motion | 0.05 to 20.0 Hz (log) | neutral 0.5 | Second LFO rate.
- lfo2.to_pitch | motion | 0.0 to 100.0 cents (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Second LFO to pitch.
- lfo2.to_filter | motion | 0.0 to 4.0 oct (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Second LFO to cutoff.
- lfo2.to_grain | motion | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Second LFO to grain position (not played until M4).
- chaos.rate | motion | 0.1 to 30.0 Hz (log) | neutral 2.0 | Speed of the random wander.
- chaos.amt | motion | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Random wander of pitch, cutoff and level.
- delay.time | space | 0.01 to 2.0 s (log) | neutral 0.375 | Echo time.
- delay.fb | space | 0.0 to 0.95 (lin) | neutral 0.35 | Echo feedback.
- delay.shift | space | -12.0 to 12.0 semitones (bipolar) | neutral 0.0 | Pitch shift inside the echo loop.
- delay.mix | space | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Echo level.
- verb.size | space | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.5 | Room size and tail length.
- verb.damp | space | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.5 | High-frequency loss in the tail.
- verb.mix | space | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Reverb level.
- verb.freeze | space | 0.0 to 1.0 (lin) | neutral 0.0 | Holds the tail forever at 1.
- width | space | 0.0 to 2.0 (lin) | neutral 1.0 | Stereo width: 0 mono, 1 as is, 2 wide.

## Band shapes

- tone_bands | tone | 16 numbers, low to high frequency (80 Hz to 12 kHz, log spaced) | -30.0 to 30.0 dB (db) | neutral 0.0 | Partial levels by frequency band, the vowel shape.
- noise_bands | tone | 16 numbers, low to high frequency (80 Hz to 12 kHz, log spaced) | -30.0 to 30.0 dB (db) | neutral 0.0 | Noise levels by frequency band.

## Macros

Eight macro sliders each push several parameters up or down. The listed weight is in normalized units at the macro extremes.

- bright: src.tilt +0.6, src.f1_freq +0.1, src.f2_freq +0.2, filt.cutoff +0.4, strike.color +0.2, verb.damp -0.1
- body: src.tilt -0.2, src.f1_gain +0.4, filt.cutoff +0.1, filt.morph -0.2
- wobble: src.jitter +0.2, tape.amt +0.2, lfo1.rate +0.2, lfo1.to_pitch +0.3, lfo2.to_filter +0.3, chaos.amt +0.2
- grit: fold.amt +0.5, clang.amt +0.2, crush.bits -0.3
- space: delay.fb +0.2, delay.mix +0.3, verb.size +0.4, verb.mix +0.6, width +0.2
- punch: env.attack -0.5, env.sustain -0.2, env.pitch_amt +0.2, strike.click +0.4
- air: src.noise_mix +0.5
- length: src.damp -0.3, env.decay +0.5, env.sustain +0.2, env.release +0.4, env.noise_decay +0.3
